english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for people or things separating or being divided.
This is the all-purpose choice for dividing things or people, including saying that something has come apart by itself.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice when people or things physically separate or go apart.
This is the all-purpose verb for physically splitting or separating things.
